pairs.subject: generated-workflow-candidates
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/Hunt.tsx:4 The Hunt turns an operator's idea into prompt leaves that a vendor (ElevenLabs, or Suno by hand) renders into audio takes, and a person picks the winner with a crown. Nothing here measures a dataset, fills a training template, trains a model or runs a hyperparameter search. A grep of _hunt/ and hunt-return/ for dataset, hyperparam, training, ensemble, statistics and template found nothing, so the subject's precondition (dataset in, trained model candidates out) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/leafReturn.ts:57 A candidate is an audio take that a vendor rendered from a prompt. It is not a generated training package.
app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/acts.ts:69 The winner is whichever take a person crowns after listening. No trained candidates are ranked by a metric.
app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/acts.ts:50 A text engine drafts the map of axes and leaves. There is no hyperparameter search backend.

pairs.registryProposal: The Hunt has the same shape as this subject but for generative media rather than trained models: generate candidates (prompt leaves), render them, have a person select a winner, and record a lesson with an n and a keep rate. The subject's precondition is limited to datasets and training, so this match is only lexical (the word 'candidate'). A separate media-generation subject on candidate provenance and selection would govern this context better.
